title: SCIS MITM · AES-DM collision

target.description: One-block full-output collision in four-round AES-128-DM with predetermined IV; equivalent to fixed-target-plaintext key collision.

setting.key_relation: The source-defined public key or public round keys.
setting.plaintext_model: Two distinct 128-bit message keys; one fixed common 128-bit IV.

memory.note: Tdp birthday table; the neutral-word table is smaller.

preprocessing.note: Setup is included in total work unless separately stated.

success.description: The full collision is analyzed by an expected-work birthday model. The reported experiment tests partial-target candidates under one index, not a complete collision-search success rate.

review.scope: PDF p.16 Eq4 and pp.22–23 Section6.

evidence.locator: PDF pp.7–12 Table1/PGV definitions; pp.16,20–23 Section6/Algorithm3.
evidence.interpretation: Defining primary-text costs, output event and conditions checked together.

limitations: The complete named output probability is not quantified by the source.

variables.name: h
variables.condition: Predetermined initial value; no IV search is allowed.

variables.name: m
variables.condition: Two distinct message values under the same chaining value.

experiment.distinctness: m != m_prime; the same h is reused for both evaluations.
experiment.reference: Ideal 128-bit compression output, birthday work approximately 2^64.
